name: Estimation ABI Reference
description: Force-model-blind covariance update reference for the ratified estimation ABI.

sequentialJustification.detail: One six-state covariance update is order-dependent and small; callers parallelize independent tracks. The artifact still uses the sanctioned wasm32-wasip1-threads compiler lane.

methods.description: Returns success after the artifact has instantiated; estimation data uses the fixed direct export documented in README.md.
